facts.text: Once a world of marshes and wetlands, it was built up with cities and streets over the years.

evidence.quote: Once a world of marshes and wetlands, it was built up with cities and streets over the years.

facts.text: Ord Radama was once an Ordnance/Regional Depot of the Galactic Republic.

evidence.quote: Ord Radama was once an Ordnance/Regional Depot of the Galactic Republic.

facts.text: During the Jedi Civil War, Ord Radama aligned with the Sith Empire.

evidence.quote: During the Jedi Civil War, Ord Radama aligned with the Sith Empire.

facts.text: During the Great Galactic War, the forces of the reformed Sith Empire attacked Ord Radama, under the command of the Sith Lord Darth Malgus.

evidence.quote: During the Great Galactic War, the forces of the reformed Sith Empire attacked Ord Radama, under the command of the Sith Lord Darth Malgus.

facts.text: Initially successful, Malgus' forces laid siege to Livien Magnus, the capital of Ord Radama, and after a week the city fell to them.

evidence.quote: Initially successful, Malgus' forces laid siege to Livien Magnus, the capital of Ord Radama, and after a week the city fell to them.

facts.text: However, the Sith forces were not subsequently resupplied and a few weeks later, the Republic sent a fleet to Ord Radama, to drive the Sith from the planet.

evidence.quote: However, the Sith forces were not subsequently resupplied and a few weeks later, the Republic sent a fleet to Ord Radama, to drive the Sith from the planet.

facts.text: The Republic ships decimated Malgus' fleet and during the engagement, a stricken Sith Harrower-class dreadnought plummeted into the atmosphere of Ord Radama and crashed into Livien Magnus, destroying the city and killing one hundred thousand of the world's inhabitants.

evidence.quote: The Republic ships decimated Malgus' fleet and during the engagement, a stricken Sith Harrower-class dreadnought plummeted into the atmosphere of Ord Radama and crashed into Livien Magnus, destroying the city and killing one hundred thousand of the world's inhabitants.

facts.text: The Sith subsequently abandoned Ord Radama and the city New Raido became the planet's new capital.

evidence.quote: The Sith subsequently abandoned Ord Radama and the city New Raido became the planet's new capital.

facts.text: However, in the aftermath of the attack, the Ord Radama natives struggled to survive, while the Republic did little to fortify the world.

evidence.quote: However, in the aftermath of the attack, the Ord Radama natives struggled to survive, while the Republic did little to fortify the world.

facts.text: Several months later, the Sith Emperor, the ruler of the Sith Empire, ordered Malgus to retake Ord Radama, and Malgus launched a fresh attack on the world.

evidence.quote: Several months later, the Sith Emperor, the ruler of the Sith Empire, ordered Malgus to retake Ord Radama, and Malgus launched a fresh attack on the world.

facts.text: The invasion did not go smoothly and Malgus' forces were confounded by the forces of the Jedi Order, but Malgus remained confident that he would be victorious.

evidence.quote: The invasion did not go smoothly and Malgus' forces were confounded by the forces of the Jedi Order, but Malgus remained confident that he would be victorious.

facts.text: During the Clone Wars, Ord Radama was a Separatist stronghold tackled by the Galactic Republic in 19 BBY during the Serenno theater of the Outer Rim Sieges.

evidence.quote: During the Clone Wars, Ord Radama was a Separatist stronghold tackled by the Galactic Republic in 19 BBY during the Serenno theater of the Outer Rim Sieges.

facts.text: Ord Radama was quickly brought under the rule of the Galactic Empire to serve as a staging post in pacifying the Outer Rim.

evidence.quote: Ord Radama was quickly brought under the rule of the Galactic Empire to serve as a staging post in pacifying the Outer Rim.

facts.text: The people of Ord Radama initially welcomed the strength and stability the Empire offered, though this relative peace was provided through the systematic oppression of any dissidents or rebels.

evidence.quote: The people of Ord Radama initially welcomed the strength and stability the Empire offered, though this relative peace was provided through the systematic oppression of any dissidents or rebels.

facts.text: Ellor Orgraal eventually became the Governor of Ord Radama and solidified his power by crushing anyone who spoke out against the Empire or himself.

evidence.quote: Ellor Orgraal eventually became the Governor of Ord Radama and solidified his power by crushing anyone who spoke out against the Empire or himself.

facts.text: General Xantus commanded the stormtroopers garrisoned on the planet and reported directly to Governor Orgraal, who believed he had the final say in all matters on his world.

evidence.quote: General Xantus commanded the stormtroopers garrisoned on the planet and reported directly to Governor Orgraal, who believed he had the final say in all matters on his world.

facts.text: However, General Xantus actually took his orders from the Imperial Intelligence Service, the true power behind the military on the world.

evidence.quote: However, General Xantus actually took his orders from the Imperial Intelligence Service, the true power behind the military on the world.

facts.text: Under the Empire, the native Devlikks were forced into servitude and, in many instances, outright slavery.

evidence.quote: Under the Empire, the native Devlikks were forced into servitude and, in many instances, outright slavery.

facts.text: Relocated in the poorest areas of the planet to make way for Imperial housing, they lived in makeshift homes and horrible conditions.

evidence.quote: Relocated in the poorest areas of the planet to make way for Imperial housing, they lived in makeshift homes and horrible conditions.

facts.text: The Devlikks came to harbor a deep hatred of the Empire and began to form a small resistance movement under the leadership of Narralla.

evidence.quote: The Devlikks came to harbor a deep hatred of the Empire and began to form a small resistance movement under the leadership of Narralla.

facts.text: During the Galactic Civil War, the planet had a strong military presence and was protected by infrequent patrols of Imperial-class Star Destroyers and the Interdictor-class Star Destroyer Eternal Wrath.

evidence.quote: During the Galactic Civil War, the planet had a strong military presence and was protected by infrequent patrols of Imperial-class Star Destroyers and the Interdictor-class Star Destroyer Eternal Wrath.

facts.text: In 0 ABY, a small band of Rebels came to Ord Radama in order to rescue Senior Advisor Setenna Hase, a valuable Alliance leader who was kidnapped by Var Narek, a traitor and an Imperial spy operating for Captain Malau Jocaos of the Imperial Intelligence.

evidence.quote: In 0 ABY, a small band of Rebels came to Ord Radama in order to rescue Senior Advisor Setenna Hase, a valuable Alliance leader who was kidnapped by Var Narek, a traitor and an Imperial spy operating for Captain Malau Jocaos of the Imperial Intelligence.

evidence.quote: Livien Magnus was the capital city of the planet Ord Radama. During the Great Galactic War, the Sith Empire attacked Ord Radama and besieged Livien Magnus, which was held by the forces of the Galactic Republic.

facts.text: The Cultural District was a district of Livien Magnus located on Ord Radama. It was very upscale, so mostly rich Imperials visited the businesses in the Cultural District.

facts.text: The palace in the capital city of Livien Magnus was the central government building of Ord Radama. It was seized by the Sith Empire during the Battle of Ord Radama in 3660 BBY.

facts.text: Narek Manor was the residence of the Narek family, a patrician bloodline of Ord Radama. Like a number of the oldest families' manors, that four-story residence lay about four kilometers from the edge of Livien Magnus, the capital city of Ord Radama.

facts.text: The Imperial Palace was a towering palace built of gray marble that was located in the center of the city of Livien Magnus, the capital of Ord Radama. In front of the Palace stood a massive statue of the Sith Lord Darth Malgus.
